hero.name: SREENIWASAN G J
hero.title: MERN Stack Developer
hero.tagline: Full-stack developer with 1+ year of experience building and shipping production ERP systems end-to-end -frontend, backend, database design, and third-party integrations like payments, biometric hardware, and GPS.

bio: I'm a full-stack MERN developer at Aalan Tech Soft, where I own production ERP systems from architecture through deployment. My flagship project, the Harwin Interior Design ERP, is a multi-branch system covering billing, inventory, and admin management that I built solo — React frontend, Node/Express REST APIs, and MongoDB schema design.

Beyond the standard web stack, I like taking on the parts most developers avoid: integrating ESSL K30 biometric hardware for attendance, wiring up GPS delivery tracking, and building payment flows with Razorpay and UPI. I also use AI coding assistants like Claude and ChatGPT as part of my everyday workflow to move faster without cutting corners on quality.
highlights: Role-based JWT authentication & admin dashboards built from scratch
Biometric (ESSL K30) and GPS hardware integrations
Comfortable extending live client systems without breaking production

education.school: Thiagarajar College of Engineering, Madurai, Tamil Nadu

projects.title: Interior Design ERP Management System
projects.description: Multi-branch ERP covering billing, inventory, and admin management. Built the React frontend, Node/Express REST APIs, and MongoDB schema, plus role-based JWT authentication and the admin dashboard from scratch. Integrated ESSL K30 biometric hardware for attendance; leading development of an in-progress GPS tracking module ("Wheel on Eye") for real-time delivery tracking.
projects.company: Aalan Tech Soft / Interior Design ERP
projects.problem: The business needed one system to manage multi-branch operations, projects, stock, billing, staff, carpenters, transport and role-based workflows instead of disconnected manual processes.
projects.solution: Built and led a MERN ERP with modular React screens, Node/Express APIs, MongoDB data models, JWT role permissions, reports and integrations for attendance and logistics.
projects.outcome: Delivered a central operational ERP used to manage day-to-day business workflows, with ongoing improvements to inventory performance, reporting and tracking.
features: Project milestone and team assignment workflow
Transport, driver and shipment tracking modules
challenges: Keeping stock and report data consistent across modules
Designing permissions for multiple operational roles
Integrating hardware and external tracking services
Optimising large inventory screens and preventing duplicate stock records

projects.title: Hotel & Restaurant ERP System
projects.description: Designed the backend database schema, built REST API routes, and implemented core workflow logic for a hotel and restaurant management system.
projects.problem: Hotel and restaurant operations required a structured backend for core business workflows and reliable data management.
projects.solution: Designed the database structure, REST API routes and backend workflow logic with Node.js, Express and database integrations.
projects.outcome: Created the backend foundation used by the ERP frontend for daily hotel and restaurant workflows.
challenges: Keeping business rules consistent across related modules
Designing reusable APIs for frontend consumption

projects.title: Secure File sharing Using Cryptography in MERN Stack
projects.description: Secure file management platform with upload/download, CRUD operations, and access protection between role-based users. Tech: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js
projects.problem: Users needed a safer way to upload, manage and exchange files with access controls rather than unrestricted sharing.
projects.solution: Developed a MERN application for protected file upload/download and role-based access with CRUD workflows.
projects.outcome: Demonstrated full-stack file-management and access-control concepts in an academic project.

projects.title: Training Institution Website
projects.description: Designed and developed a responsive static website for a training institution. The website includes a modern landing page, course highlights, trainer profiles, testimonials, and a contact section. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap, focusing on clean UI, responsiveness, and user-friendly navigation.

projects.title: Business Website & ERP System
projects.description: Developed a Business Website & ERP System for an industrial automation and training organisation, featuring a responsive website, centralized ERP, and admin panel. The system includes multi-branch management, lead and enquiry tracking, student admissions, course enrolment, faculty assignment, role-based access, and reporting to streamline business and training operations

projects.title: Jewellery Management System
projects.description: Developed and maintained a Jewellery Management System by enhancing existing features, resolving production bugs, and implementing client-specific requirements. The system supports jewellery sales, gold loans, chit schemes, exchange transactions, billing, inventory, and customer management, ensuring smooth and efficient business operations.

projects.title: Trust & Welfare Management System
projects.description: Developed a Trust & Welfare Management System featuring a responsive website, centralized management system, and admin panel. The platform manages member registrations, welfare schemes, scholarships, financial assistance claims, online payments, and beneficiary records with role-based access for administrators, agents, and members. Integrated a secure payment gateway and built modules for application processing, payment tracking, reports, and website content management.

projects.title: Portfolio Website with Admin Panel
projects.description: Developed a personal portfolio website with a centralised admin panel for dynamic content management. The admin dashboard allows administrators to manage all portfolio sections, including About, Skills, Experience, Projects, Education, Certifications, Achievements, Services, Contact Information, and Social Media links. Any content added or updated through the admin panel is automatically reflected on the portfolio website in real time. The system includes secure authentication, image uploads, resume management, and responsive design, providing an easy-to-use interface for maintaining a professional online portfolio without modifying the source code.
projects.problem: Updating a static portfolio required source-code changes every time a project, skill, resume or profile detail changed.
projects.solution: Built a dynamic React and Node.js portfolio with an authenticated admin console so content, projects, resume, appearance and analytics can be managed without editing source code.
projects.outcome: A maintainable portfolio platform that can be updated from the browser and extended with new modules.
features: Dynamic hero, about, skills and contact content
Separate work and personal project management
Visitor analytics and project view tracking
Multipage project case studies and contact inbox
challenges: Keeping public and admin UI in sync with one data source
Handling uploaded files across frontend and backend origins
Adding analytics without blocking the public UI
